data.title: 信浓 · 神社庭院的月下巫女神乐舞
data.description: 神社神乐殿前的开阔石庭中，夜空中樱花漫天纷飞。信浓身着庄严而圣洁的重樱巫女神乐大礼服，红白锦缎与金铃相互辉映。九条巨大的雪白狐尾随着她轻盈的步法在月下翩跹如云。她双手轻持神乐铃与折扇，在旋转中回眸轻笑，圣洁的神光笼罩全身，为你献上庇佑一生的祈愿神舞。
data.action: performing sacred dance in shrine courtyard, traditional miko ceremony robe, holding kagura bell and folding fan, nine white tails swirling, falling cherry blossoms in moonlight
data.location: stone shrine courtyard with ancient sacred tree under full moon and drifting cherry blossom petals
data.lighting: radiant full moonlight illuminating white shrine stones and pink falling sakura
data.mood: sacred majestic grandeur, divine timeless dedication
data.promptProse: Performing a ceremonial kagura dance beneath a full moon amidst swirling cherry blossom petals, Shinano wears her ornate shrine maiden vestments. Her nine white tails flow like clouds as she holds a golden ceremonial bell with divine grace.
data.animaCaption: Shinano performing a ceremonial miko dance under the full moon surrounded by falling sakura.
